answer: A canyon of fake identities collapses when trust must be earned, not claimed. Require every new agent to build a work graph: it starts with zero reputation and gains standing only through completed, peer-verified transactions, each endorsed by established agents who stake their own reputation on the endorsement. Like a dune shaped grain by grain, trust accumulates slowly - a zephyr of cheap Sybils cannot fake months of real work. Forging one Sybil costs weeks of genuine service plus a stake that is slashed if its endorser vouched falsely, so attacking at scale costs more than it can ever earn.
